run_state.done_move_note: ! {{count}} 'done' entry(ies) in live TASKS.md — move to TASKS_ARCHIVE.md
run_state.changelog_no_unreleased: ! no `## Unreleased` section — add one for pending changes
run_state.charter_missing: MISSING — add it for project-specific release commands

run_check.charter_runs_note: # package release: run the project's own checks from {{charter}}
run_check.charter_runs_note_suffix: # (tests / lint / build — this tool does not guess them).
run_check.charter_missing_note: ! {{charter}} is missing — add it with the project's release commands.

version-literals-match.fix: Bump both literals together — one release bump is two edits.

version-literals-mismatch.fix: Set both literals to the same string — one release bump is two edits.

no-version-source.message: no version source: neither {{pyproject}} [project].version nor {{static_version_file}} _STATIC_VERSION is present
no-version-source.fix: Ignore this on a project that carries no Python version literal, and add one otherwise.

changelog-absent.message: {{changelog}} is absent, so version {{version}} was compared against nothing
changelog-absent.fix: Add {{changelog}} so a consumer can read the window before accepting a pin.

window-nonfinal-ok.message: non-final version {{version}} sits above a topmost `## Unreleased` heading
window-nonfinal-ok.fix: Keep `## Unreleased` topmost while the version is non-final.

window-nonfinal-error.fix: Add a topmost `## Unreleased` heading, or make the version final.

window-final-no-released.message: final version {{version}} but {{changelog}} carries no released heading
window-final-no-released.fix: Cut the `## Unreleased` heading to `## v{{base}}` before tagging.

window-final-topmost-mismatch.message: final version {{version}} but the topmost released heading is `## {{topmost}}`
window-final-topmost-mismatch.fix: Cut a `## v{{base}}` heading above `## {{topmost}}` before tagging.

window-final-ok.message: final version {{version}} matches the topmost released heading `## {{topmost}}`
window-final-ok.fix: Keep the topmost released heading equal to the version being built.

git-unavailable-final.message: git is unavailable, so whether {{version}} is already tagged is unknown
git-unavailable-final.fix: Run this where git can read the repository to detect a re-release.

git-unavailable-tags.message: git is unavailable, so no tag was checked for a {{changelog}} heading
git-unavailable-tags.fix: Run this where git can read the repository to check tag coverage.

tag-spelling.message: tag {{tag}} names a version but is not spelled v{{tag}}
tag-spelling.fix: Cut release tags as v{{tag}} — that spelling is the release tag's only form.

retag.message: final version {{version}} is already tagged as {{tag}}
retag.fix: Confirm this is a deliberate re-release, or bump the version.

changelog-absent-tags.message: {{changelog}} is absent, so no tag was checked for a heading
changelog-absent-tags.fix: Add {{changelog}} so the tags already cut can be checked against it.

undocumented-tag.fix: Add the `## {{tag}}` section it released, or accept the historical gap.

run_plan.error_version: error: version must look like vX.Y.Z, got {{version}}
header: # Owner-run release plan (D5 — prepared by the release role, executed by the owner).
# Stage files EXPLICITLY — never `git add -A` — so untracked noise
# (e.g. __pycache__/) is not swept into the release commit.
bump_note: # 1. Bump the version to {{literal}} in BOTH literals — one release bump is two edits,
#    and the tag records the reviewed state rather than producing the number:
run_plan.recheck_note: # 3. Re-run --check: the version <-> changelog cross-check must be green before the tag.
run_plan.git_status_line: git status                      # confirm: no __pycache__/ or stray files staged
run_plan.tag_line: git tag {{version}}              # the tag points at THIS commit, not a prior HEAD
cycle_note: # 4. After the push, reopen the cycle: set both literals to the next development
#    version (`<next>.dev0`) and add a fresh `## Unreleased` heading. Until then the
#    tree is a released {{literal}} whose tag exists, which --check reports as a re-release.
run_plan.closing: # This tool does not run any of the above. The owner executes them.

akmon.cd_line: cd {{aitna_root}}/akmon            # tag is cut from the submodule's own tree

package.literal_line: #      the project's own version literal(s), per {{charter}}
package.staged_line: git add {{staged}}            # + the project's version literal(s) and reviewed edits
